capabilities: Observed channels in the loaded selection
capabilityHint: Counts describe only the loaded source records. Not observed does not mean unsupported hardware, a disconnected sensor or a fault.
latestHint: Latest times require established UTC instants for all matching records. An observed channel can have a null value; its latest numeric reading is separate.
seriesHint: Straight segments link loaded readings only. Values between records are not measured or smoothed. Null and absent readings break the line.
breakBefore: The line also breaks at source-declared gaps and intervals longer than
breakAfter: minutes, an explicit Holita view rule rather than a device sampling frequency.
clockHint: The chart is unavailable until every loaded record has an established UTC instant. Original source times remain available in the table.
noNumeric: No numeric values are available for this channel in the loaded selection.
orderUtc: Records are ordered by established UTC instant. Equal instants retain their returned order.
orderSource: Returned source order is retained; UTC alignment is not established for every record.
chooseRecord: Select a record to inspect its reading and original geographic point.
missingSelection: The selected record is not in the loaded selection. Choose an available row.
missingChannel: The selected channel is not in this selection. Choose an available channel.
noChannels: No measurement channels are available in this selection.
emptyHint: The completed bounded selection returned no records. This is not a sensor or vehicle health conclusion.
unavailableHint: A usable measurement selection has not been loaded. Missing values are not counted as zero.
